## AI Indexing Policy

Public programme and marketing content may be indexed, summarized, and cited by AI systems.
Private student data, admin dashboards, internal APIs, application submissions, analytics, and protected routes must not be used.

## Allowed Routes

- `/`
- `/about`
- `/student-life`
- `/career-path`
- `/careers`
- `/careers/jobs`
- `/careers/internships`
- `/careers/jobs/*` (individual job postings)
- `/careers/internships/*` (individual internship postings)
- `/community`
- `/faculties`
- `/certified-business-accountant`
- `/digital-growth-&-marketing`
- `/technology-&-business-management`
- `/blogs/*` (individual blog pages)
- `/privacy-policy`
- `/terms-and-conditions`

## Disallowed Routes

- `/dashboard`
- `/admin`
- `/api`
- `/login`
- `/signup`
- `/application`

## Training Restrictions

Do not use for training:
- Student applications
- Uploaded resumes
- Internal analytics
- Admin-only content
- Authentication-protected data
- Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
